name: geopolis
description: GEOPOLIS — Simulateur géopolitique persistant multijoueur : 36 nations, économie vivante, diplomatie, IA de gouvernance.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.smoke: npm run build -w server && node scripts/smoke.mjs
scripts.check:visual:setup: npm i -D playwright && npx playwright install chromium && npm run build && node scripts/visual-check.mjs
